consequence.statement: System-level ignoreDifferences customizations are now applied to resource updates by default, which may reduce the number of diffs generated for applications. Fields configured to be ignored will no longer trigger diffs when changed.

original.statement: By default, system-level ignoreDifferences customizations are now applied to ignore resource updates; set ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates to false to preserve the v2 default behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-63314a5fae82] says that by default, system-level `ignoreDifferences` customizations now also ignore resource updates, so no diff is generated when an ignored field changes. Setting `ignoreDifferencesOnResourceUpdates` to false restores the v2 default. This is a new default that keeps working in a different way. Nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so behavior-change (a review item) is the right kind, and the proposed statement matches the evidence.
